project: Cu-Cr-Nb-X CALPHAD + Machine Learning + Out-of-Domain Generalization

conventions.partition_definition: n_i_alpha = phase_moles_alpha * X_i_alpha ; P_i_alpha = n_i_alpha / sum_beta n_i_beta. phase_volume_fraction * element_mole_fraction is FORBIDDEN.
conventions.failed_state_policy: FAILED states are RETAINED as rows with state_converged = 0, all *_volfrac / *_molefrac / P_* = NaN and all *_presence = 0. They are never deleted, never interpolated, and never substituted from a neighbouring temperature.
conventions.auxiliary_rule: Columns ending in _AUX are diagnostic. They must never enter the 5-family sum-to-one constraint, a softmax over families, or any normalisation of the core targets.
conventions.instance_numbering: Raw suffixes #1/#2/#3 carry NO physical identity. Never define a phase by its instance number; judge identity from phase composition.
forbidden_derived_quantities: any mechanical or electrical pseudo-label derived from CALPHAD equilibria
conventions.sealed_element: NI - zero occurrences anywhere in FULL_V1

FULL_V1_ML_TARGET_ALL.note: Complete target table INCLUDING the 1,568 FAILED states. Use this when the failure pattern itself is being studied.

columns.name: state_id
columns.description: Unique key of one (composition, temperature) equilibrium state.

columns.name: composition_id
columns.description: Composition key. THIS IS THE ONLY GROUP KEY ALLOWED FOR train/test splitting (spec 55): all 11 temperatures of one composition must stay on the same side of every split.

columns.name: family
columns.description: Alloy family: BASELINE, ZR, TI, CO, SI, AG, MO. Ni is sealed and never appears.

columns.name: X_element
columns.description: Quaternary solute symbol; empty string for BASELINE (Cu-Cr-Nb only).

columns.name: sampling_domain
columns.description: A = dense interior, B = extrapolation shell, ANCHOR = literature-anchored perturbation. Used to define the OOD composition-domain split.

columns.name: Cu_wt_pct
columns.description: Cu content; balance element.

columns.name: Cr_wt_pct
columns.description: Cr content. Derived from (S_CrNb, R_CrNb_atomic) - never sampled independently.

columns.name: Nb_wt_pct
columns.description: Nb content. Derived from (S_CrNb, R_CrNb_atomic) - never sampled independently.

columns.name: X_wt_pct
columns.description: Quaternary solute content; NaN/0 for BASELINE.

columns.name: S_CrNb_wt_pct
columns.description: S_CrNb = wCr + wNb. Primary sampling variable.

columns.name: CrNb_atomic_ratio
columns.description: R_CrNb_atomic = (wCr/51.9961)/(wNb/92.9064), as realised after 4-decimal rounding. Primary sampling variable.

columns.name: state_converged
columns.description: 1 = Thermo-Calc equilibrium converged, 0 = FAILED. FAILED rows are RETAINED with NaN targets (spec 52): they are a physical result, not a data gap.

columns.name: solver_level_used
columns.description: Escalation level that produced the result: 0 direct, 1 rebuilt calculation, 2 rebuilt TC-Python session, 3 adaptive temperature bridge.

columns.name: bridge_used
columns.description: True if a Level-3 adaptive temperature bridge was needed.

columns.name: BCC_total_mole_fraction

columns.name: has_multiple_FCC_instances

columns.name: has_multiple_BCC_instances
columns.description: 1 iff two or more raw BCC_B2#n instances are stable - a BCC miscibility gap. Observed only in MO at T<=950 C. Where this is 1 the dominant-family label is degenerate; use the continuous partition values.

FULL_V1_ML_READY_CONVERGED.note: state_converged == 1 subset. This is the default table for supervised training.

FULL_V1_ML_TARGET_PREVIEW.note: Produced by 23_fullv1_partitioning.py; FULL_V1_ML_TARGET_ALL is a byte-for-byte re-export of it.

FULL_V1_DERIVED_DESCRIPTORS.note: Per-composition equilibrium descriptors collapsed across the temperature grid. Equilibrium quantities only.

columns.name: composition_id
columns.description: Composition key (one row per composition).

columns.name: X_Cr_FCC_450
columns.description: Equilibrium Cr mole fraction inside the FCC matrix at 450 C.

columns.name: X_Cr_FCC_950
columns.description: Equilibrium Cr mole fraction inside the FCC matrix at 950 C. NaN for every MO composition whose 950 C state FAILED - which is all 1,568 of them - so Delta_XCr_FCC_950_450 is NaN for those compositions too.

columns.name: Delta_XCr_FCC_950_450
columns.description: EQUILIBRIUM Cr DEPLETION PROXY = X_Cr_FCC_950 - X_Cr_FCC_450. This is an equilibrium difference between two independent equilibrium states. It is NOT a kinetic precipitation driving force, NOT a nucleation rate, and NOT any mechanical or electrical property (spec 47).

columns.name: C15_volfrac_450
columns.description: C15 volume fraction at 450 C.

columns.name: C15_volfrac_600
columns.description: C15 volume fraction at 600 C.

columns.name: Delta_C15_600_450
columns.description: C15_volfrac_600 - C15_volfrac_450; equilibrium difference only.

columns.name: C15_volfrac_max
columns.description: Maximum C15 volume fraction over the 11-point grid.

columns.name: LIQUID_onset_C
columns.description: Lowest grid temperature at which LIQUID_presence == 1; NaN if LIQUID never appears on the grid. This is bounded by the 11-point grid resolution and is NOT a measured solidus: it can only ever take one of the 11 grid values, and 'NaN' means 'no liquid at or below 1000 C', not 'no melting'.

columns.name: BCC_split_closure_C
columns.description: Highest grid temperature at which two BCC instances are still stable; NaN if never split. CAVEAT: this is the highest OBSERVED split temperature, not the true closure temperature. For the 1,568 MO compositions whose 950 C state FAILED, the 950 C point is unknown, so this column reports 900 C even though the split is known to persist at 950 C in the compositions that did converge there. Read it together with FULL_V1_FAILURE_MAP.parquet; never treat 900 C as a measured closure for those compositions.

columns.name: FCC_split_closure_C
columns.description: Highest grid temperature at which two FCC instances are still stable; NaN if never split.

columns.name: family
columns.description: Alloy family.

columns.name: X_element
columns.description: Quaternary solute; empty for BASELINE.

columns.name: sampling_domain
columns.description: A / B / ANCHOR.

FULL_V1_COMPOSITIONS.note: Sampling table: composition_id, family, X_element, sampling_domain, Cu/Cr/Nb/X_wt_pct (4-decimal, as fed to Thermo-Calc) plus *_exact full-precision columns, S_CrNb_wt_pct, R_CrNb_atomic_target / _actual, and the Sobol global index of each point.

FULL_V1_EQUILIBRIUM_STATES.note: Per-state solver record: converged, solver_level_used, bridge_used, bridge_temperatures_C, attempt_count, final_status, original_error_message, error_message, wall time.

FULL_V1_PHASE_COMPOSITIONS_LONG.note: element_mole_fraction X_i_alpha inside each raw phase instance.

FULL_V1_FAILURE_MAP.note: Every non-converged state with its composition, solver level, bridge attempts and the verbatim Thermo-Calc error. All 1,568 are MO at 950 C.

FULL_V1_RAW_PHASE_INVENTORY.note: Complete raw vocabulary observed in the 550,000 states.

FULL_V1_SOLVER_DIAGNOSTICS.note: Solver level, attempt count and bridge record for every state.

FULL_V1_FILE_HASHES.note: SHA256, size and mtime of every FULL_V1 file.

FULL_V1_DATA_MANIFEST.note: Row counts, byte totals and pointers to the hash file, this schema and the freeze policy.

ood_split_policy.hard_rule: One composition NEVER appears on both sides of any split. All 11 of its temperature rows move together.
ood_split_policy.axis_1_composition_domain: train on sampling_domain A, test on sampling_domain B (extrapolation shell).
ood_split_policy.axis_2_unseen_element: hold out one entire X family (e.g. all MO compositions) from training.
ood_split_policy.axis_3_temperature: hold out a temperature band; report in-band and out-of-band scores separately.
ood_split_policy.sealed_blind_test: NI is reserved for a future prospective unseen-element test and is absent from FULL_V1.

known_caveats: MO compositions below 950 C show a BCC miscibility gap; where has_multiple_BCC_instances == 1 the dominant-family labels are degenerate. Train on the continuous partition values and carry has_multiple_BCC_instances as a feature.
The 1,568 FAILED states are all MO at 950 C, where the BCC miscibility gap closes. They are a physical result of the TCCU6 description, not a sampling gap, and must not be deleted or interpolated.
LIQUID appears in only 1,955 states (all ZR, all 1000 C, max 3.32 vol.%). LIQUID targets are severely imbalanced; report LIQUID metrics separately rather than folded into a macro average.
FCC splits in 8,676 states, all AG, all at or below 400 C.
Baseline (Cu-Cr-Nb) rows have no X element: every X_P_* column is NaN there by construction, never 0.

Descriptors that collapse the temperature axis inherit the FAILED states as NaN, and BCC_split_closure_C in particular degrades silently: an MO composition whose 950 C state failed reports 900 C. Any model or figure using that column must join FULL_V1_FAILURE_MAP.parquet and mask the affected compositions.
